title: A Slack analytics bot for your team over ClickHouse
outcome: Let your team ask data questions in Slack: answers come from governed datasets over your ClickHouse, and revenue never lands in a channel that shouldn't see it.

env.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-…), from OAuth & Permissions after installing the app

env.name: SLACK_APP_TOKEN
env.description: Socket Mode: app-level token (xapp-…) with connections:write. Set this or SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.

env.name: SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET
env.description: HTTP mode: the app's Signing Secret (Basic Information)

env.name: SLACK_MEMBERS
env.description: Who may ask, as <slack user id>:<analyst|admin>, comma-separated

env.name: SLACK_CHANNELS
env.description: Channels the bot answers in, with each channel's ceiling role, as <channel id>:<analyst|admin>

env.name: AI_MODEL
env.description: Chat model as <provider>:<model id> (default anthropic:claude-opus-5-5; openai:<id> also works)

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key, for the default model. Use OPENAI_API_KEY with an openai: model instead.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_URL
env.description: Your ClickHouse HTTP endpoint (default http://localhost:8123, the seed)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Database holding the seed tables (default hypequery_examples)

exampleRequest: In Slack: @hypequery events by type last month
